prose:
A launch post presents a browser walkthrough of weight-space editing for a small Qwen model. The author explicitly says the intended full inspect-edit-evaluate loop exceeded available video memory and was replaced by an interactive example.

The extracted page contains almost no explanatory text. The reported fraction of edited weights and reduction in repetition were not reproduced, and the walkthrough should not be described as a complete autonomous in-browser training system.
highlights: Full proposed loop exceeded memory limits
Walkthrough differs from a general system
